notes: Identity checked independently: canonical text identifies Memory’s penumbra: Episodic memory decisions induce lingering mnemonic biases, Katherine Duncan, Arhanti Sadanand, and Lila Davachi; Science 2012 Jul 27;337(6093):485–487; DOI 10.1126/science.1221936. This is a PMC-hosted author manuscript with full main-text sections, not merely an abstract or secondary account. The linked supplementary DOC content is not included; no PDF was supplied. Only es_value_o is assigned. Study label 1b is not explicitly identified in the supplied main text; the text references Exp 1a in SOM. Potential Experiment 1 tests include preceding-response accuracy (t=3.32, p<.005), adjusted preceding-response Wald chi-squared=8.9 (p<.005), preceding-trial-type accuracy (t(14)=3.41, p<.005), RT, and similarity interaction tests. These are candidates only, not mapped by numeric agreement or order. No OR is printed in the inspected main-text results. Missing supplementary study/method detail prevents selecting a unique test or declaring OR absent from the whole work. All statistic values remain null; no conversion performed. Unassigned fields are placeholders.
